The bill would allow all Australians to marry regardless of sex, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
It would repeal 2004 amendments to the Marriage Act 1961 that defined marriage under the Constitution.
The bill would not impose any conscience obligations on people who object to same-sex marriage for religious or non-religious reasons.
